top_signals.title: How Threat Actors Are Turning Trusted AI Platforms Into an Attack Surface
top_signals.summary: Threat actors are abusing trusted AI platforms to host malicious content, poison search results, and trick users into installing malware. Huntress examines campaigns targeting AI users through weaponized Claude Artifacts, shared AI conversations, sponsored search results, and ClickFix-style lures. [...]

top_signals.title: Lululemon’s Newest Bear Sees More Pain Ahead After 81% Rout
top_signals.summary: Lululemon Athletica Inc.’s turnaround won’t be a quick or easy fix as the athletic wear company cedes market share to rivals and suffers deepening sales declines, according to BMO Capital Markets, which initiated coverage of the stock this week with an underperform rating.

top_signals.title: Hungary Gives Targeted Payments to Offset Soaring Fuel Costs
top_signals.summary: Hungary will give 20,000 forints ($64) per car to hundreds of thousands of drivers through the end of the year to help offset the impact of soaring fuel prices, the government said.
